summary: Onto Innovation Inc. filed an 8-K on April 21, 2026, announcing a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire 61,123,436 shares (27% of outstanding shares) of Rigaku Holdings Corporation from Atom Investments, L.P. (an affiliate of The Carlyle Group) for approximately $710 million. The implied price per share is roughly $11.61. The acquisition is expected to close in H2 2026, subject to HSR antitrust clearance, other regulatory approvals, and customary conditions. A termination fee equal to 2% of the purchase price applies under certain circumstances. Watch for regulatory hurdles and financing details; risk-arb spread will reflect timing and deal certainty.
